_note: A tax on employment the employee pays (article 276(2)). Under SALARIES because s.19(1) Table Sl. 1 (1961 s.16(iii)) deducts it in computing that head; paid out of salary, so CASH_OUTFLOW and not salary — it feeds SAL-TAX-ON-EMPLOYMENT, not SAL-SALARY-INCLUDES (D-093).
head: SALARIES

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 1, p.41: "Sum paid by the assessee as a tax on employment" — paid by the employee, hence a cash outflow; 1961 s.16(iii) (thc.nic.in p.140) the same for TY 2025-26
